meta.note: max_active counts only tasks the AGENT can act on. A task parked at a gate or waiting on an answer is on Rajat's desk, not the agent's, and must not consume the slot — otherwise one unreviewed task halts everything. max_open caps the total sitting in tasks/active/ regardless of state, so work cannot pile up on his desk unbounded. max_claims_per_day is the runaway backstop. max_attempts here is the DEFAULT; a project config's budget.max_attempts overrides it, same as repo/delivery/test_cmd do.
